author: musho7-dev
subject: Stop cars vibrating: tuned spring damping, 120 Hz physics
body:
The stiffer weight-based springs from the suspension fix bounced on the
light wheels, so cars trembled (worst on heavy trucks and karts).
Measured parked shaking for 8 cars over a grid of spring settings
(tools/shake_test.gd) and picked damping 4.0 for all springs: total
shaking dropped from 5.8 to 0.3 while wheels still sit in the arches.
Physics now runs at 120 Hz to match the iPhone's 120 Hz screen, so
motion is smoother. Difficulty unchanged (no-upgrade cars still end
around 500 m out of fuel).
